cases.name: Jeanette P. Calabrese Cunliffe
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Jeanette was Director of HRIS/HR Operations at Sidley Austin LLP.  Jeanette enjoyed spending time with her family and friends, going on vacations, and always had a smile for everyone she met. She will be missed by all who knew and loved her."
cases.narrative: On 1/14/2024, her daughter found her during a welfare check.
